svg.text: Vector masters, native 16 px exports, light and dark stencils, and outlined wordmarks.
Two rounded groups of different lengths sit above a short rail.
The mint right group is the selected group. Clear one-pixel gaps
Typeface: JetBrains Mono Bold, outlined from the installed font
into real SVG paths. The masters have no font dependency.
A low horizontal rhythm, not Omarchy's chunky pixel lettering or
notched frame. Unlike omagnet's Snap Grid, it has no square
ring, four quarters or snapping corner.
A single capsule is divided once, with a one-pixel vertical
seam. The amber right section can be read as splitting away or
joining the left. Shared outer curvature makes it one pill.
Typeface: JetBrains Mono Bold, outlined from the installed font
into real SVG paths. The masters have no font dependency.
A smooth horizontal capsule with one seam, unlike Omarchy's
pixel construction. Unlike omagnet's Snap Grid, it uses two
adjacent parts and no open square or four-part ring.
A bold rounded B carries two stacked horizontal pill counters. A
blue lower bowl makes the pair visible in colour, while the
silhouette and both counters carry the idea in one colour.
Typeface: JetBrains Mono Bold, outlined from the installed font
into real SVG paths. The masters have no font dependency.
An asymmetric rounded initial, unlike Omarchy's pixel lettering
and notched frame. Unlike omagnet's Snap Grid, it is a solid
letter with stacked counters, not a square ring of four equal
